additional_info.subject: RE: ID0400892-DC/Si-D/SE [MP / S3 170003392] Outlet two not working. CRM:01410001391
additional_info.body:
Dear Magnus Hellberg,
We have tried resetting the converter groupings of the charger, however, we can still see the error that DC3 is missing converters. In the logs as well, we have seen that only 8/10 charger converters grouped, so we are suspecting that the converters are having some issue with its wiring. We request you to please check the wirings to TB9 and TB10 converters, and let us know if they are powering up or not.  For 400kW Si-D, the placement of TB9 and TB10 will be as per the 2nd image (orange converters).
Regarding your 2nd observation for precharge, we can see in the old logs that the precharge voltage value is going upto 300V, and not staying at 5-8V, so I am not sure about this. Could you please let me know the exact timeline when you observed this?
Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to hearing from you
.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shreyas Sathe
Please do not change the subject of this Email when replying to it.
